name: Wendy's Amulet
text: Wendy Adams deck only. You may play the topmost event card in your discard pile as if it were in your hand. Forced - After you play an event: Place it on the bottom of your deck instead of in your discard pile.
text_cn: 温蒂·亚当斯牌组专用。 你可以将弃牌堆最上面的事件牌当作手牌来打出。 强制 - 在你打出一张事件牌后：将其放到你的牌堆底部，而非弃牌堆。
